name: Small Sidebar Font
description: Reduces tab text and sidebar font size including pinned tabs
author: Custom
style: zen-tab-item, zen-tab-item *, .tab-label, #zen-workspaces-button *, .zen-essentials-container *, #pinned-tabs-container *, .tabbrowser-tab[pinned] * { font-size: 10px !important; } zen-tab-item, .tabbrowser-tab[pinned] { min-height: 24px !important; max-height: 24px !important; }
